about: DescribeRules' vectors (server/internal/setup/mapc/rules.go): a map's rules section and the summary and short text players read. The Go tests and the map editor's self-test check against them.

cases.name: Kill Race
cases.summary: First to 20 kills or most kills after 25 minutes wins.

cases.name: a kill race alone
cases.summary: First to 20 kills wins.

cases.name: Sudden Death 15
cases.summary: Most kills after 15 minutes wins.

cases.name: one kill, one minute
cases.summary: First to 1 kill or most kills after 1 minute wins.

cases.name: the design's example
cases.summary: First to 20 kills or most kills after 15 minutes wins; everyone starts at level 6; respawn 8 s + 0.5 s a level + 0.5 s a minute.

cases.name: Brawl
cases.summary: First to 25 kills or most kills after 20 minutes wins; everyone starts at level 6; respawn 6 s + 0.25 s a level; 1,500 starting gold, kill gold x1.5; no surrender (only when a player is gone).

cases.name: First Binding
cases.summary: First to destroy a Binding wins.

cases.name: a Binding race
cases.summary: First to destroy 3 Bindings wins.

cases.name: a Binding race with kills
cases.summary: First to 20 kills or to destroy 3 Bindings wins.

cases.name: a Binding race with minutes
cases.summary: First to destroy 3 Bindings or most Bindings after 20 minutes wins (then kills).

cases.name: every win condition with a start level
cases.summary: First to 20 kills or to destroy 3 Bindings, or most Bindings after 20 minutes wins (then kills); everyone starts at level 6; 1,500 starting gold.

cases.name: a Binding race and Bindings that come back
cases.summary: First to destroy 8 Bindings wins; Bindings return 2 min after they fall.

cases.name: Gold Rush
cases.summary: 1,500 starting gold, 300 gold a minute, kill gold x2; wells open at 5:00.

cases.name: Siege
cases.summary: A minion wave every 25 s; Bindings return 4 min after they fall.

cases.name: Late Game Now
cases.summary: Everyone starts at level 10; 4,000 starting gold.

cases.name: partial members
cases.summary: Respawn time grows 0.5 s a minute; minions at 30.5 s; passive gold from 0:30; XP x1.5; wells relock 1 min 30 s after a capture, well gold x0.5; surrender from minute 10.

cases.name: respawn growth only
cases.summary: Respawn time grows 1 s a level and 0 s a minute.

cases.name: the widest short text
cases.summary: First to 200 kills or most kills after 90 minutes wins; everyone starts at level 20; XP x2.

cases.name: the widest victory
cases.summary: First to 200 kills or to destroy 12 Bindings, or most Bindings after 90 minutes wins (then kills).

cases.name: surrender allowed only
cases.summary: Surrender allowed.

cases.name: surrender off wins over its time
cases.summary: No surrender (only when a player is gone).

cases.name: zeros
cases.summary: Respawn 0 s; minions at 0:00; 0 starting gold, 0 gold a minute, kill gold x0; wells open at 0:00, well gold x0.

cases.name: every member
cases.summary: First to 20 kills or most kills after 15 minutes wins; everyone starts at level 6; respawn 8 s + 0.5 s a level + 0.5 s a minute; minions at 0:30, then every 25 s; 1,500 starting gold, 200 gold a minute from 0:30, kill gold x1.5; XP x1.5; Bindings return 5 min after they fall; wells open at 5:00, relock 2 min after a capture, well gold x1.5; surrender from minute 10.
